title: GDScript reference
key_points: GDScript is a high-level, object-oriented, imperative, and gradually typed programming language built for Godot.
It uses an indentation-based syntax similar to Python.
Its goal is to be optimized for and tightly integrated with the Godot Engine.
GDScript is entirely independent from Python and not based on it.
The source includes a history of GDScript, examples of GDScript code, identifiers, keywords, and more.
limitations: The documentation about GDScript's history has been moved to another section
Does not cover the full scope or usage of GDScript language
asserts: GDScript is a programming language built for use with Godot Engine, optimized for tight integration and flexibility.
